summary: 8:30 AM ET run, published at 9:05 ET. Nothing settled, nothing open to close, nothing published. The board is unchanged from the 7:19 run: the same three totals clear the model lean bar and all three are still priced on a single relayed DraftKings number with no second book, so all three are still held. Both captures skipped again because no game is inside two days. The availability sweep did turn up one entry worth the record.
takeaways: Alec Pierce is doubtful for Houston at Indianapolis on Sunday, reported at 9:03 PM last night. He is the player behind our first early-exit credit, when he left Sunday's game in the first half and DraftKings returned the stake on a prop that still counts as a loss at zero units. A doubtful tag five days out usually means he does not play, and our projections remove a doubtful player entirely rather than cutting him to 75%. Worth knowing before anyone looks at a Colts receiving line this week.

The rest of the overnight injury list is mostly last night's inactive sheet carried forward rather than new week 3 news: Micah McFadden and Deonte Banks for the Giants, Ty Simpson for the Rams. Real week 3 practice reports start Wednesday, and college availability reports come later in the week. There is nothing to read yet that would move a number.

The three held totals are unchanged to the decimal: Iowa at Michigan over 38.5 at 57.3% against 52.8% needed, Seahawks at Commanders over 40.5 at 54.7% against 50.5%, Ravens at Cowboys under 52.5 at 55.2% against 51.9%. Zero of the 222 open game rows on the board carry more than one book this morning. The multi-book capture opens on Saturday's college games from Thursday and on Sunday's NFL games from Friday, and that is when these get a real decision rather than a relayed one.
